title: Port of Portland Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of certain assets of North Western Shipping & Towage

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Port of Portland Pty Limited, the port owner and operator, proposed to acquire the towage business of North Western Shipping and Towage (NWST) that operates at the Portland Port.
body_sections.Market definition: Without reaching a final view the ACCC considered that the relevant market was likely to be the market for the provision of harbour towage at the Port of Portland.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that there was a high degree of integration between the Port of Portland Limited and NWST as a result of the pre-acquisition contractual arrangements between the parties. The ACCC also noted comments from market participants that there was insufficient demand at Portland to justifiy a second towage operator. On a with and without analysis, the ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition.
